title: Buying principles
body:
Value = price per kg / l / piece in EUR, after checking a promo has not expired. Pack price is never the comparison.
Comparison unit follows how the item is bought: weight (per kg), liquids (per l), counted things (per piece).
Health first: a cheaper product with added sugar or heavy processing is shown, but never ranked best for health.
Daily drivers are tracked tightly; one-off purchases only when cheap to check.
Stale data is not a price: older than 90 days, or an ended promo, counts as unknown until re-checked.
Only price reductions are promos. Shipping, minimum orders and pack options go in the note.
Prices are append-only: a changed price is a new row; an unchanged price only gets a new checked date.
Every price has an origin (yours or auto) and a source.
